messages:
Alex S: FYI a customer (acme) reporting sudden dedicated errors - 429s + spikes in latency, started ~10:12 PST. They say tenant kept getting routed to coldpool even though tier=gold.
Maya C: escalation from CS, they've attached logs, raising to oncall.
ACME Infra: We're seeing repeated 429s (quota_exceeded) and backend logs show pool=dedicated-cold-3 even though our tag header is "tier:GOLD".
Alex S: tagging @Jamie M oncall
Jamie M: looking. Can you paste request headers + route-decision trace? Also which model/pool? Any recent rule changes?
ACME Infra: Here's header snippet and response header from our side:
```http
X-Redwood-Tier: "GOLD"
X-Redwood-Tenant: "acme-prod"
X-Route-Decision: tier=gold -> pool=dedicated-cold-3
```
ACME Infra: controlplane debug: `selected_pool: dedicated-cold-3; reason: tier_mismatch; eval: tierKey == "gold" -> false`
Priya R: hmm. Control plane started coercing numeric/string/quote normalization in last deploy. Could be a case/coercion bug. Need repro.
Jamie M: repro quick check: send header `X-Redwood-Tier: GOLD` vs `gold` - behavior differs. Oncall confirms rule eval treating values as lowercased but our tier map keys are uppercase.
Priya R: copying the recent change: `normalize_headers_to_lowercase_values=true` was intended for CSV arrays only. Looks like it slipped into tag parsing.
Maya C: impact summary for customer: gold tenants fell back to cold pools -> autoscaler didn't scale warm/dedicated and customers hit throttles/noisy neighbor effects.
Alex S: temporary mitigation options: 1) set tenant override `force_pool=dedicated-warm-1` for acme, or 2) add a permissive rule matching lowercase values. Which is faster?
Jamie M: I can pin the tenant to a pool now (option 1). Also preparing a quick rule change to accept both cases.
DeployBot: scheduled canary deploy of controlplane v2.13.1 to staging at 10:45 for the normalization fix.
Priya R: planned fix: treat header values as opaque strings; only apply normalization to header names and CSV splitting. PR #4321 opened.
ACME Infra: applied pin. Errors dropped immediately on our side, will watch for 30m. Thanks.
Jamie M: follow-up action - Priya, can you run a query for route_eval logs where original_value != normalized_value and rule_name contains "tier" over last 2h? We want scope.
Priya R: running now, quick stat: ~12k evals where `GOLD` -> `gold` in last 2h across 7 tenants. Pushing fix to canary.
Maya C: customer confirmed reduced 429s and lower latency, asking for ETA for full fix and rollback window.
Jamie M: ETA for full patch + safe rollback: 4 hours. Will monitor canary and then promote. :thumbsup:
ACME Infra: confirming 429s are back to baseline after pin. Appreciate the quick ops.
Alex S: filing a short incident doc and adding a unit/integration test to prevent value normalization regressions. Closing loop once patch promoted.
